runners.name: Nickyb
runners.comment: NICKYB broke outwardly, set the pace along the inside early on, vied with an outer pair into and around the turn, shook free at the furlong grounds and drove clear.

runners.name: Mission Achieved
runners.comment: MISSION ACHIEVED broke a step slow and was brushed by an inner foe at the start, tugged forward to prompt two wide and between horses, vied around the turn, sparred outside of the eventual winner in upper stretch but proved no match in the final furlong and was second best.

runners.name: Informer
runners.comment: INFORMER bumped the gate while being forced outwardly at the start, prompted three deep, vied around the turn, yielded in the four path in upper stretch then lasted for show.

runners.name: Harborcoat
runners.comment: HARBORCOAT broke outwardly, trailed in the four to three path, fanned to the five path in upper stretch, stayed on mildly and missed show.

runners.name: Joe Joe Dude
runners.comment: JOE JOE DUDE tracked along the inside then lacked a bid.

runners.name: Glen Morgan
runners.comment: GLEN MORGAN brushed an outer foe at the start, steadied in tight passing the five furlong pole, chased two wide and weakened.

runners.name: Wild Acclaim
runners.comment: WILD ACCLAIM tracked from the four to three path into the turn, inched closer around the bend, rallied to bid in the five path at the furlong grounds and drove past.

runners.name: Lilmorecraken
runners.comment: LILMORECRAKEN prompted two wide, vied around the turn, led in the three to four path in upper stretch but hung on her left lead and was caught by an outer bidder late.

runners.name: Sweet Magnolia
runners.comment: SWEET MAGNOLIA set the pace along the inside, vied with an outer prompter around the turn, got headed in upper stretch then kept on while hanging on her left lead.

runners.name: Moremi
runners.comment: MOREMI raced off of the pace in the three path then stayed on mildly, fell after the gallop out, got up and was transferred off of the track in an equine ambulance.

runners.name: Tiz Salty
runners.comment: TIZ SALTY was bumped by an outer rival and forced inwardly at the start, lagged in the two path, swung to the five path entering the lane and moved up.

runners.name: Silvertown
runners.comment: SILVERTOWN was fractious in the starting gate, broke inwardly and bumped a foe, raced off of the pace along the inside and failed to factor.

runners.name: Mint Driven
runners.comment: MINT DRIVEN prompted in the three to four path early on, then chased before weakening around the turn.

runners.name: Heart Headed
runners.comment: HEART HEADED bumped with an inner foe at the start, laid off of the pace in the three path and between horses, shifted four wide into upper stretch, rallied to bid in the final furlong and drove past at the sixteenth pole.

runners.name: Cheval de Guerre
runners.comment: CHEVAL DE GUERRE was bumped on both sides at the start, stalked the top pair from the three to two path into the turn, took aim outside of the embattled leading pair in upper stretch, ranged up to bid among foes in the final furlong but got outkicked by an outer counterpart then saved place at the wire.

runners.name: Bobrovsky
runners.comment: BOBROVSKY veered inwardly at the start, trailed along the inside, rallied into the final furlong, altered out five wide at the sixteenth pole and sustained belated progress to miss place.

runners.name: Amoudi Bay
runners.comment: AMOUDI BAY vied for the lead with an outer rival around the turn, dueled through upper stretch but got outkicked by outer bidders at the sixteenth pole and yielded.

runners.name: Our Starry Night
runners.comment: OUR STARRY NIGHT chased along the inside, steadied slightly entering the turn, chased in the two path in upper stretch, shifted out in the final furlong and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Zakinthos
runners.comment: ZAKINTHOS bumped with an outer foe at the start, vied two wide, dueled into the lane but faded between rivals in the final furlong.

runners.name: War At Sea
runners.comment: WAR AT SEA raced off of the pace in the four to five path and failed to factor.

runners.name: Jasmine Absolute
runners.comment: JASMINE ABSOLUTE bumped an inner foe at the start, set the pace along the inside while vying with an outer pair into the turn, sparred with an single outer rival earing the lane, shook free in midstretch then drew off through the final furlong under a drive.

runners.name: French Sand
runners.comment: FRENCH SAND prompted three deep into the turn, bid and sparred outside of the eventual winner turning for home, but proved no match in midstretch then lasted for place.

runners.name: A Last Crack At It
runners.comment: A LAST CRACK AT IT was bumped by an outer rival at the start, lacked speed along the inside, progressed between horses before moving back to the inside leaving the three sixteenths pole, sustained a rail rally but ran out of ground to reel in place.

runners.name: Looks Perfect
runners.comment: LOOKS PERFECT raced off of the pace near the inside, edged show from an outer foe in the two path in midstretch but got outkicked.

runners.name: Dreamology
runners.comment: DREAMOLOGY was slow into stride, trailed in the three to four path before fanning to the six path entering the lane, ran on while leaning inwardly and flattened out.

runners.name: London Roads
runners.comment: LONDON ROADS tracked from the three path, chase din the four path and between rivals in upper stretch but lacked a bid.

runners.name: Wauwinet
runners.comment: WAUWINET raced close up along the inside early on, chased from the four path around the turn then faded between rivals in the final furlong.

runners.name: Sweet Buttercup
runners.comment: SWEET BUTTERCUP raced off of the pace in the four path and failed to factor.

runners.name: Shea Boulevard
runners.comment: SHEA BOULEVARD raced off of the pace in the three path and between horses, shifted out to the six path in upper stretch and made little impact.

runners.name: Goodbye Girl
runners.comment: GOODBYE GIRL vied two wide, keen passing the five furlong pole, sparred between rivals into the turn but faltered around the bend.

runners.name: Dosc
runners.comment: DOSC raced off of the pace two wide and between horses, inched closer under urging around the turn, shifted out to the five path leaving the three sixteenths pole, reeled in the leader while changing to his right lead at the furlong grounds and kicked clear.

runners.name: Captain Call
runners.comment: CAPTAIN CALL set the pace in the two path, built a clear advantage with nine sixteenths to go, met an outer challenge nearing the lane, repelled that bidder in upper stretch but offered little resistance to a wider challenge at the furlong grounds and was second best.

runners.name: Mystic D
runners.comment: MYSTIC D raced off of the pace in the three to four path, shifted inwardly then stayed on to edge show at the sixteenth pole.

runners.name: Good Lies
runners.comment: GOOD LIES stalked from the four to three path into the turn, bid outside of the leader turning for home but was repelled in upper stretch and yielded.

runners.name: Croatoan
runners.comment: CROATOAN lagged behind near the inside, shifted to the five path in midstretch and moved up.

runners.name: Mambo Man
runners.comment: MAMBO MAN lacked speed along the inside and failed to factor.

runners.name: Big Mike Fink
runners.comment: BIG MIKE FINK chased forwardly along the inside, chased around the turn, stopped and was eased through the final furlong.

runners.name: Army Run
runners.comment: ARMY RUN prompted outside of the leader early on, but faltered around the turn and was eased thereafter.

runners.name: Mandy's Man Can
runners.comment: MANDY'S MAN CAN set a clear pace in the two path then held sway under a drive.

runners.name: Admiral Hall
runners.comment: ADMIRAL HALL tracked along the inside, forged place from an outer rival at the three furlong pole, proved no match for the clear leader then held place.

runners.name: Good Mojo
runners.comment: GOOD MOJO stalked from the three path, got headed for place by an inner rival at the three furlong pole, kept on through the lane and lasted for show.

runners.name: Daiquiri Sommelier
runners.comment: DAIQUIRI SOMMELIER broke inwardly, raced off of the pace in the two path, pursued in the four to five path leaving upper stretch then stayed on to miss show between horses.

runners.name: Buck's Howl
runners.comment: BUCK'S HOWL raced off of the pace in the three path, floated to the five to six path in upper stretch then stayed on mildly to miss show.

runners.name: Ur Benja
runners.comment: UR BENJA trailed in the four path, fanned to the six path into upper stretch and made little impact.

runners.name: Pierre
runners.comment: PIERRE stalked along the inside, awaited racing room while boxed in the pocket turning for home, smoothly tipped to take aim outside of the clearing leader entering upper stretch, sustained gradual progress to bid in the final sixteenth and wrestled an advantage at the wire.

runners.name: Restore (FR)
runners.comment: RESTORE (FR) set the pace along the inside, shook clear entering the lane, held sway through midstretch, but flopped back to his left lead at the sixteenth pole and got nailed at the wire.

runners.name: Lucky Mischief
runners.comment: LUCKY MISCHIEF was put to tight quarters between rivals soon after the start, rated at the rear along the inside, inched closer entering the far turn, continued to save ground before advancing inside of rivals entering upper stretch, edged show at the three sixteenths pole then held that position late.

runners.name: Tough Little Nut
runners.comment: TOUGH LITTLE NUT laid off of the pace two to three wide and between horses, then in the three to four path around the far turn before swinging to the seven path entering the lane, rallied into the final furlong but leveled off and edged fourth late.

runners.name: Rothschild
runners.comment: ROTHSCHILD tracked two wide, then between horses leaving the first turn, ranged closer four deep turning for home to take aim entering the lane but flattened out.

runners.name: Pitkin
runners.comment: PITKIN stalked two wide and between horses, then midpack around the far turn and chased evenly.

runners.name: Real Fast
runners.comment: REAL FAST steadied back from between horses, laid off of the pace along the inside, trailed in the two path turning for home, fanned out to eight to nine path in midstretch and improved position.

runners.name: Clyde's Got a Gun
runners.comment: CLYDE'S GOT A GUN pursued from midpack three to four wide, then three wide around the far turn, drifted to the five to six path entering the lane and lacked a rally between horses.

runners.name: Esmark
runners.comment: ESMARK stalked three wide, tossed his head leaving the first turn, prompted two wide and between rivals around the far turn then gave way.

runners.name: Lincoln Highway
runners.comment: LINCOLN HIGHWAY was antsy in the starting gate, got very rank among foes early on, pulled forward in the five path around the first turn, pressed three deep into the far turn then weakened between horses entering the lane.

runners.name: Unionista
runners.comment: UNIONISTA pressed four wide, bid at the three furlong pole, vied in the path into the lane, dueled between rivals in upper stretch then drove clear leaving the furlong grounds.

runners.name: Jem's Hershey Kiss
runners.comment: JEM'S HERSHEY KISS tracked from midpack two to three wide and between rivals into the turn, inched closer in the four path around the bend, took aim while fanning to the six path entering the lane, bid and vied through upper stretch but was turned away in the final furlong.

runners.name: Stakeholder
runners.comment: STAKEHOLDER prompted three wide and between horses, bid among foes around the turn, chased in the four path into upper stretch and kept on to re-edge show late.

runners.name: Tegatron
runners.comment: TEGATRON vied two wide, then between horses around the turn, dueled in the three path into the lane then yielded through the final furlong.

runners.name: Page Two
runners.comment: PAGE TWO raced close up in the two path, took aim inside of the leaders in upper stretch but lacked a bid and yielded.

runners.name: Four Dimes
runners.comment: FOUR DIMES broke slowly, raced at the rear two wide, spun into the lane in the three path and moved up between horses.

runners.name: Amalgamate
runners.comment: AMALGAMATE tracked five wide, came under urging within range around the turn, fanned to the seven path entering the lane and tired.

runners.name: Premiere Dancer
runners.comment: PREMIERE DANCER chased along the inside then tired.

runners.name: Cerberus
runners.comment: CERBERUS vied inside of a host of rivals into the turn, got headed at the five sixteenths pole and weakened.

runners.name: Johnny Ringo
runners.comment: JOHNNY RINGO broke slowly and got outrun along the inside.

runners.name: Federal Agent
runners.comment: FEDERAL AGENT chased four wide and between horses, faltered around the turn and was eased turning for home.

runners.name: Spur of the Moment
runners.comment: SPUR OF THE MOMENT pressed two wide and between horses into the backstretch, bid outside of the leader rounding the far turn, wrestled an advantage in upper stretch before shifting across her inner counterpart's path inside the final three sixteenths then drew off.

runners.name: Anna Bo Banna
runners.comment: ANNA BO BANNA set the pace along the inside, met a pair of outer challenges around the far turn, got headed by her most immediate counterpart in upper stretch, steadied when put to tight rail quarters by that one in side the final three sixteenths and proved second best.

runners.name: Dolly P
runners.comment: DOLLY P tracked along the inside, chased around the far turn, then in the two path into the lane, edged show in upper stretch and lasted.

runners.name: Oh She Said Yes
runners.comment: OH SHE SAID YES pursued from midpack while keen behind kickback in the three path around the first turn, chased in the four to five path and between horses in upper stretch then prevailed for fourth.

runners.name: Marblehead
runners.comment: MARBLEHEAD lacked speed three to four wide, fanned to the six path into upper stretch and stayed on to miss fourth.

runners.name: Donie Maronie
runners.comment: DONIE MARONIE stalked three wide, bid rounding the far turn but yielded in upper stretch and gave way.

runners.name: Mooberry
runners.comment: MOOBERRY lacked speed near the inside and failed to menace.

runners.name: Lady Biz
runners.comment: LADY BIZ trailed along the inside and got outrun. THE RIDER OF ANNO BO BANANA CLAIMED FOUL AGAINST SPUR OF THE MOMENT ALLEGING INTERFERENCE IN UPPER STRETCH, BUT THE OBJECTION WAS DISALLOWED BY THE STEWARDS.

runners.name: Sunshine Daydream
runners.comment: SUNSHINE DAYDREAM set the pace along the inside, shook free of an outer prompter entering the lane then held late.

runners.name: Surprise Ending
runners.comment: SURPRISE ENDING steadied along the inside nearing the first turn, saved ground in midpack, rallied up the rail through midstretch, shifted to the two path in the final sixteenth, bid outside of the leader and along with outer rivals late but missed.

runners.name: Sneakily
runners.comment: SNEAKILY settled in the two path, progressed three wide around the far turn, fanned to the six path into the lane and rallied to miss place.

runners.name: Charm of Venice (GB)
runners.comment: CHARM OF VENICE (GB) steadied between horses early on, rated at the rear two to three wide, swung seven wide into upper stretch and rallied.

runners.name: The Grumpy Rabbit
runners.comment: THE GRUMPY RABBIT stalked along the inside, awaited racing room around the far turn, took aim from the two path in upper stretch, but drifted to the three path at the furlong grounds and yielded between horses.

runners.name: Ellesmere Island
runners.comment: ELLESMERE ISLAND eased back between horses early on, tracked near the inside, chased in the two path in upper stretch, checked subtly when encountering traffic leaving the furlong grounds then kept on evenly.

runners.name: Stir
runners.comment: STIR bumped with an outer rival at the start, saved ground off of the pace but to no avail.

runners.name: The Palace Girl (GER)
runners.comment: THE PALACE GIRL (GER) bumped with an inner foe at the start, held up behind rivals early on, rated at the rear along the inside, swung to the eight path in upper stetch then improved position.

runners.name: Temple Goddess
runners.comment: TEMPLE GODDESS pressed two wide, chased leaning to the three path entering the lane then faded between horses.

runners.name: Good Game
runners.comment: GOOD GAME stalked from the three path, shifted to the five path entering the lane and faded.

runners.name: Struck At Midnight
runners.comment: STRUCK AT MIDNIGHT pursued from midpack in the three to two path, chased in the five path and between rivals into the lane and failed to factor.

runners.name: Rhapsody in Motion
runners.comment: RHAPSODY IN MOTION lacked speed two wide, then between horses around the far turn and never got involved.
